description: End-to-end LPWAN (LoRaWAN/NB-IoT) subscription and traffic fraud detection, investigation, and remediation workflow for a Telecom-as-a-Service IoT platform.

tenant_id.description: Identifier for the enterprise/customer tenant using the LPWAN service.

device_id.description: Globally unique identifier for a provisioned LPWAN device (e.g., DevEUI/IMEI wrapper).

fraud_case_id.description: Identifier for a fraud investigation case opened in the system.

alert_id.description: Identifier for a specific fraud alert instance.

policy_id.description: Identifier for a fraud detection or mitigation policy.

rule_id.description: Identifier for an individual rule belonging to a policy.

network_profile_id.description: Identifier for a network behavior profile (baseline) of a device or tenant.

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: register_network_profile
functions.description: Create or update a baseline network behavior profile for a tenant or device, used for anomaly-based fraud detection.

scope.description: Defines whether the profile is for an entire tenant or a single device.

tenant_id.description: Target tenant for the network profile; required when scope is 'tenant'.

device_id.description: Target device for the network profile; required when scope is 'device'.

profile_name.description: Human-friendly name for the network profile.

description.description: Detailed description of the expected behavior captured by this profile.

traffic_baseline.description: Expected traffic patterns, used as a baseline for anomaly detection.

uplink_messages_per_hour.description: Typical number of uplink messages per hour.

downlink_messages_per_hour.description: Typical number of downlink messages per hour.

peak_hours.description: List of expected high-traffic hour ranges in local time.

avg_payload_size_bytes.description: Expected average payload size of uplink packets.

allowed_roaming_regions.description: List of allowed roaming country/region codes in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

constraints.description: Hard behavioral limits beyond which traffic is considered suspicious.

max_daily_messages.description: Maximum allowed messages per day before flagging.

max_monthly_data_mb.description: Maximum allowed data volume per month in MB.

functions.returns: Network profile ID and current configuration.

functions.name: create_fraud_policy
functions.description: Create a fraud detection policy with one or more rules targeting LPWAN traffic anomalies.

tenant_id.description: Tenant where this policy will be enforced; can be global if omitted or special-tenant is used.

description.description: Detailed description of the policy's intent.

scope.description: Scope in which the policy applies.

target_devices.description: Optional filters describing which devices are affected by the policy.

lpwan_types.description: Restrict policy to certain LPWAN technologies.

rules.description: Collection of rules that together define the policy.

severity.description: Impact assessment when this rule triggers.

min_score.description: Minimum anomaly score to trigger the rule.

model_version.description: Identifier of the anomaly detection model used.

forbidden_zones.description: List of polygons representing geofenced forbidden areas.

actions.description: Actions to execute when the rule triggers.

enabled.description: Whether this rule is currently active.

functions.returns: Policy ID and summary of created rules.

functions.name: update_fraud_policy
functions.description: Modify an existing fraud detection policy, including rule updates and status changes.

policy_id.description: Identifier of the policy to update.

updates.description: Partial updates to apply to the policy.

add.description: Rules to add to the policy.

update.description: Rule updates referencing existing rule IDs.

remove_rule_ids.description: List of rule IDs to remove from the policy.

reason.description: Reason for updating the policy, for audit logging.

functions.returns: Updated policy metadata and list of affected rules.

functions.name: list_fraud_policies
functions.description: List and filter fraud policies, optionally scoped by tenant or status.

tags.description: List of tags that must all be present on the policy.

functions.returns: Paginated list of fraud policies matching filters.

functions.name: evaluate_device_risk
functions.description: Compute a real-time fraud risk score for a specific device based on recent LPWAN traffic and active policies.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the device; used for scoping policies.

time_window.description: Time window over which to evaluate risk.

lookback_minutes.description: Number of minutes before now to consider for traffic statistics.

end_time.description: Optional explicit end time; defaults to now if omitted.

include_details.description: Whether to include detailed breakdown of contributing rules and metrics.

context.description: Additional contextual info for more accurate risk evaluation.

network_profile_id.description: Reference to a specific network profile as baseline.

functions.returns: Current risk score (0-100), qualitative rating, and optionally rule-level contributions.

functions.name: stream_fraud_alerts
functions.description: Subscribe a consumer endpoint to receive real-time fraud alerts for a tenant or device subset.

subscription_name.description: Human-readable name of the alert subscription.

tenant_id.description: Tenant whose alerts will be streamed.

filter.description: Criteria used to restrict which alerts are delivered.

delivery.description: Configuration of how alerts are delivered.

endpoint.description: Delivery endpoint configuration, polymorphic by mode.

retry_policy.description: Delivery retry policy on endpoint failure.

functions.returns: Subscription ID and effective filter/delivery configuration.

functions.name: get_fraud_alert
functions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific fraud alert, including related device activity.
functions.returns: Full details of the fraud alert and optionally related contextual information.

functions.name: open_fraud_case
functions.description: Open a fraud investigation case for one or more alerts or devices, grouping related incidents into a single workflow.

tenant_id.description: Tenant where the suspected fraud occurs.

description.description: Detailed narrative of the suspicion and context.

related_alerts.description: List of alert IDs associated with this case.

related_devices.description: List of device IDs associated with this case.

initial_classification.description: Initial estimation of fraud type and severity.

confidence.description: Analyst or system confidence level between 0 and 1.

owner.description: Analyst or team responsible for the case.

tags.description: Case-level tags for reporting and routing.

functions.returns: Fraud case ID, initial status, and linkage to related alerts/devices.

functions.name: update_fraud_case_status
functions.description: Update fraud case status, add notes, and optionally reclassify the fraud type.

fraud_case_id.description: Identifier of the fraud case to update.

resolution.description: Optional resolution details when closing or resolving a case.

financial_impact_estimate.description: Estimated financial impact in the tenant's billing currency.

add_comment.description: Optional comment to add to the case timeline.

reclassify.description: Optional updated classification of the fraud pattern.

functions.returns: Updated fraud case record, including new status and timeline entry.

functions.name: apply_device_mitigation
functions.description: Apply mitigation actions (suspend, throttle, re-key) to one or more devices implicated in fraud alerts or cases.

devices.description: List of devices to apply mitigations to.

current_status.description: Observed status for information, not for validation.

actions.description: Mitigation actions to apply to each device.

throttle_percent.description: Maximum allowed traffic percentage when throttling.

rekey_force_new_app_skey.description: For LoRaWAN: whether to rotate application session key.

fraud_case_id.description: Optional fraud case that motivated the mitigation, for audit linkage.

reason.description: Narrative explanation of why mitigations are being applied.

dry_run.description: If true, only simulate and report impact without executing.

functions.returns: Per-device mitigation results, including success/failure and any simulated impact when dry_run=true.

functions.name: rollback_device_mitigation
functions.description: Rollback previous mitigation actions applied to devices, restoring normal operation where safe.

fraud_case_id.description: Fraud case that initiated the mitigations to rollback; used to locate related actions.

devices.description: Devices to rollback. If omitted, all devices linked to fraud_case_id are considered.

safety_checks.description: Optional safety criteria that must be met before rollback is allowed.

require_no_new_alerts_minutes.description: Require no new high/critical alerts in this timeframe for the device.

max_current_risk_score.description: Maximum acceptable real-time risk score for rollback.

reason.description: Reason for rollback, e.g., case marked as false positive.

force.description: If true, bypass safety checks (if allowed by policy).

functions.returns: Summary of rollback operations per device, including any devices where rollback was skipped due to safety checks.

functions.name: retry_alert_processing
functions.description: Reprocess a fraud alert when previous processing failed or when detection logic has changed (e.g., new policy version).

alert_id.description: Identifier of the alert to retry.

mode.description: Whether to replay raw events or only re-evaluate policy rules on stored metrics.

use_policy_version.description: Optional explicit policy version to use for re-evaluation; defaults to latest active.

dry_run.description: If true, do not persist changes to the alert; return hypothetical re-evaluation results only.

functions.returns: New evaluation outcome for the alert, including changed severity, status, or linked case if persisted.

functions.name: summarize_fraud_activity
functions.description: Generate a summary report of fraud activity and mitigation actions for a tenant over a given period.

tenant_id.description: Tenant for which to summarize fraud activity.

timezone.description: Timezone used for grouping and display.

group_by.description: Dimensions by which to group fraud statistics.

include.description: Sections to include in the report.

filters.description: Additional filters narrowing the report scope.

functions.returns: Fraud activity report in the requested format and a URL to download if applicable.

functions.name: get_fraud_case_timeline
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological timeline of events, comments, alerts, and mitigations associated with a fraud case.

filters.description: Optional filters for what entries to include.

page.description: Page number for paginating timeline entries.

functions.returns: Ordered list of timeline entries for the specified fraud case, with pagination metadata.

functions.name: search_lpwan_fraud_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across lpwan_fraud entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching lpwan_fraud entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_lpwan_fraud_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N lpwan_fraud records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_lpwan_fraud_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many lpwan_fraud records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_lpwan_fraud_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many lpwan_fraud records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_lpwan_fraud_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of lpwan_fraud data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_lpwan_fraud_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a lpwan_fraud dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_lpwan_fraud_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more lpwan_fraud entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_lpwan_fraud_snapshot
functions.description: Restore lpwan_fraud state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_lpwan_fraud_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the lpwan_fraud workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_lpwan_fraud_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across lpwan_fraud metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_lpwan_fraud_audit_events
functions.description: Search the lpwan_fraud audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_lpwan_fraud_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers lpwan_fraud workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_lpwan_fraud_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for lpwan_fraud events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_lpwan_fraud_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for lpwan_fraud events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_lpwan_fraud_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off lpwan_fraud job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_lpwan_fraud_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled lpwan_fraud jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_lpwan_fraud_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled lpwan_fraud job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_lpwan_fraud_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a lpwan_fraud operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_lpwan_fraud_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a lpwan_fraud action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_lpwan_fraud_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a lpwan_fraud approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_lpwan_fraud_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any lpwan_fraud entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_lpwan_fraud_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a lpwan_fraud entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_lpwan_fraud_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling lpwan_fraud behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_lpwan_fraud_policies
functions.description: List lpwan_fraud policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_lpwan_fraud_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two lpwan_fraud-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_lpwan_fraud_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a lpwan_fraud entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.
